product_description.value:
A slim double-wall insulated water bottle that fits easily into school bags. In the supplier's lab test (LT-2291) it keeps drinks cold for up to 24 hours and hot for up to 12 hours, and its screw lid passed a 24-hour inverted leak test (QC-221).

The body is made from 18/8 (SS 304) food-grade stainless steel (MD-304-2026) with a blush pink powder-coated finish. Hand wash only with warm soapy water; it is not dishwasher safe. Do not freeze.

claims.text: insulated; keeps drinks cold for up to 24 hours and hot for up to 12 hours
